name: cahut
description: Publish documents, decks and dashboards to your Cahut, and share them by link. It connects Claude to your Cahut over MCP, and teaches it the formats, the sandbox of Windows and Knock first.

domain.title: Domain of your Cahut
domain.description: The domain where your Cahut answers, such as cahut.example.com, without https://. Claude connects to its MCP endpoint, and you sign in to choose what it may do.
